questions.question: In head-to-head T20 meetings, who has the edge, Dolphins or Cobras?
At which ground did Dorothy Mathekga record their career-best innings (32, T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Kimberley Oval, against Heat on 2022/10/30.

questions.question: At which ground did Dragons record their 'Highest Total' (List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Potchefstroom Oval — highest total of 420, against Boland on 2019/02/02.

questions.question: South Africa Women have only ever won one Test match in their history. Who was the opponent, and in what year?
questions.explanation: South Africa's sole Test victory came against the Netherlands in 2007, the only Test the two sides have ever played against each other.

questions.question: At which ground did Cobras record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Recreation Ground — largest win by runs of 109, against Badgers on 2024/12/15.

questions.question: At Newlands Stadium, who holds the record for 'Most Matches' (List A)?
questions.explanation: Nosipho Vezi holds it with 19, a joint record shared with Leah Jones.
